controls.name: Voluntary safe storage outreach
controls.required_evidence: Owner-independent anonymized adoption and comprehension audit
controls.hard_stop: No household ownership registry or mandatory disclosure

controls.name: Temporary secure storage referral network
controls.objective: Offer lawful and voluntary option during acute household risk
controls.hard_stop: No physical acceptance of firearms by schools

controls.name: Evidence-based threat assessment
controls.required_evidence: Independent case review; sampled dispositions; appeal test
controls.hard_stop: No adverse finding solely from protected expression or anonymous tip

controls.name: Verified multi-channel emergency alert
controls.objective: Warn and coordinate without automated irreversible action
controls.required_evidence: Blinded alert tests and accessibility review
controls.hard_stop: No deployment with single unverified sensor failure mode

controls.name: Sensor validation and provenance
controls.objective: Understand misses, false positives and adversarial input
controls.hard_stop: No force or confinement automated by detector

controls.name: Safe classroom protection and egress
controls.required_evidence: AHJ and disability-access review; outage tests

controls.name: Continuity of critical systems
controls.objective: Keep alerts and releases usable in outages
controls.hard_stop: No failure mode that disables all emergency communications

controls.name: Bleeding-control readiness
controls.required_evidence: Training skills test; periodic kit inspection

controls.name: Professional coordination and lawful force
controls.objective: Reduce confusion and prevent unauthorized coercion
controls.required_evidence: MOU, credentialing, law review, exercise evaluation
controls.hard_stop: No unqualified armed staffing or AI force authority

controls.name: Canine use subject to evidence
controls.required_evidence: Independent double-blind tests and welfare checks
controls.hard_stop: No assumed mass-shooting efficacy or dangerous unvalidated search

controls.name: Cyber-physical assurance
controls.objective: Prevent compromised technology from increasing harm
controls.required_evidence: Segmentation, update policy, outage and rollback exercises
controls.hard_stop: Stop when attackers could remotely lock exits

controls.name: AI decision support gate
controls.hard_stop: No automatic offender profile, adverse action or force

controls.name: Constitutional and privacy audit
controls.objective: Prevent abuse, retaliation and unlawful transfers
controls.required_evidence: Independent authority, FERPA data-flow, complaint reviews
controls.hard_stop: Any misuse of authority, retaliation or unlawful redisclosure

controls.name: Accessible and inclusive emergency practice
controls.required_evidence: ADA/504 review and inclusive tabletop drills
controls.hard_stop: Failure to provide meaningful emergency access

controls.name: Shared learning without exposure
controls.hard_stop: No security-sensitive blueprints or identifying records in public package
